description: Search Jobven job postings with the filters of GET /v1/public/jobs. Returns 10 jobs by default (at most 25) with a plain-text excerpt of each description; get_job has the full text. Pass nextCursor back as cursor, with the same filters, for the next page. Each job returned counts toward the monthly allowance.

city.description: City, comma-separated; case and accents are ignored

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "US", "CA", "GB". "XX" matches jobs with no location at all.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous search_jobs result, same filters

descriptionQuery.description: Search job descriptions for a whole-word phrase, matched literally, case-insensitive. Slower than the other filters; pair it with postedAfter.

hasRelocation.description: true: postings that offer relocation help; false: postings that say they do not

hasVisaSponsorship.description: true: postings that offer visa sponsorship; false: postings that say they do not

language.description: Required spoken language, ISO 639-1 code, e.g. "fr"

limit.description: Jobs per page, default 10, at most 25

listedAfter.description: Listed at or after (Unix seconds), by listedAt: for incremental sync

location.description: Free-text location: city, region or country

maxSalary.description: Maximum yearly starting pay, as minSalary

minSalary.description: Minimum yearly pay; hourly, daily, weekly and monthly pay is compared per year. In each job's own currency unless salaryCurrency is set

q.description: Search job titles by whole word. Words are ANDed in any order; "double quotes" match an exact phrase, OR matches either side, and a leading - excludes a word. Case-insensitive. Does not search descriptions (see descriptionQuery).

salaryCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the salary, e.g. USD, EUR, PLN

state.description: State, province or region, comma-separated: full name ("Ontario") or, for the US and Canada, the postal code ("ON")

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
